title.narrative: Strengthening the public-private partnership model in the South Sudan TVET ecosystem

description.narrative:
In line with UNESCO's TVET Strategy 2022-2029, this project’s outcome is to strengthen the quality of TVET delivery in South Sudan through institutionalizing public-private sector engagement based on India’s NSDC public-private partnership model. The project’s outputs are: (1) increased public-private partnerships to improve sector specific TVET training in South Sudan to bridge skills mismatches; and (2) enhance capacity of South Sudan TVET officials represented in the National Ad Hoc TVET Coordination Committee to institutionalize public-private partnership models, processes and governance frameworks to deliver TVET.
UNESCO has led and continues to lead TVET projects in South Sudan supported by the Government of Sweden and the Capacity Development for Education programme of UNESCO that strengthen governance mechanisms, data systems and qualifications/quality assurance frameworks for TVET and for the African Development Bank (AfDB), specifically in the agricultural sector. Two Sector Skills Bodies in Agriculture and Construction were established through UNESCO’s support in 2024. The projects provide an existing structure that would improve the sustainability and institutionalization of this South-South and Triangular Cooperation (SSC/TC) project.
